content.short: Connect businesses and customers through our rewards and community engagement program.
content.description: Clanity strives to build a self-sustaining community all over the world by connecting businesses with their customers through our blockchain rewards and engagement program. Clanity is the first blockchain technology that attempts to simplify and efficiently reward a large number of individuals who make subjective contributions to local businesses all around the world with a universal utility token.
content.meta: Find out about Clanity (CLAN) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
